notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection only fetches title and description; favicon and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-07: List items expose title, description, and tags but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Existing tags are shown as an unfiltered reuse list, not autocomplete driven by the entered text.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Search lacks AND/OR/NOT operators, grouping, and quoted-operator handling.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact matches.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action implementation.
REF-BM-21: There is no bulk action over the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: The list has only a fixed order and no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but markdown is not rendered.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
